topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I always thought I knew everything about the places Jordan worked. I mean, we’ve been friends for what feels like forever, chatting almost every day. But yesterday, Jordan mentioned some project at work, and it just didn’t line up with what I’d heard before. It’s not just a small detail; it’s like the entire job is something else entirely. Now, every time I think about our conversations, little things stick out, little inconsistencies I never noticed. I keep replaying everything, wondering how I missed it. Maybe I should talk to Jordan, get some clarity. But part of me hesitates, unsure if I really want to know the details.
